subject: planner: constant propagation supports more join type in the logical plan builder (#61909)
summary: Adds `rule.FlagConstantPropagation` when building `LogicalApply` via `buildApplyWithJoinType`, enabling constant predicate pull-up + subsequent predicate pushdown to propagate outer constants into inner subquery plans (notably improving correlated scalar subquery / UPDATE patterns). Includes only minor refactor in `LogicalJoin.outerJoinPropConst` and updates integration/issue tests to cover the new optimization behavior. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in planner changes.
